meta.title: SSO / SAML 2.0: on failure — admin alerted
gaps: Configure the tenant's SSO / SAML 2.0 integration with the specified provider and parameters
Make the external SAML provider fail or become unreachable
Trigger a Procol user login through SAML
Observe and verify the resulting admin alert and corresponding state, alert, log, or retry record
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure the tenant's SSO / SAML 2.0 integration with the specified provider and parameters; Make the external SAML provider fail or become unreachable; Trigger a Procol user login through SAML; Observe and verify the resulting admin alert and corresponding state, alert, log, or retry record

args.need: configure the tenant's SSO/SAML 2.0 integration, make the external provider fail or become unreachable, attempt a user login through Procol, and verify visible evidence that the admin was alerted and the failure was not silently dropped

steps.note: No catalog step can configure SAML, simulate an external identity-provider outage, trigger SSO login, or inspect admin alert/log/retry evidence.
Final assertion required by the plan format; it only checks that the screen is not crashed or showing raw errors and does not cover the SSO alert behavior.
